    START["Start CLI"] --> CMD_INPUT["User enters command"]

    ROUTE -- "add" --> ADD_FLOW["Process Add Task"]
    ROUTE -- "list" --> LIST_FLOW{"Output Format?"}
    ROUTE -- "complete" --> COMP_FLOW["Process Completion"]
    ROUTE -- "remove/clear" --> REM_FLOW["Process Removal"]
    ROUTE -- "unknown" --> ERR_UNK["Display Error: Unknown Command"]
    LIST_FLOW -- "--json" --> JSON_OUT["Serialize to JSON"]
    LIST_FLOW -- "default" --> TEXT_OUT["Format as Table/List"]
    ADD_FLOW --> VAL_ADD{"Valid Input?"}
    VAL_ADD -- "No" --> ERR_VAL["Display Validation Error"]
    VAL_ADD -- "Yes" --> SAVE_ADD["Save to ~/.todos.json"]
    REM_FLOW --> VAL_ID{"ID Exists?"}
    VAL_ID -- "No" --> ERR_NF["Display Not Found Error"]
    VAL_ID -- "Yes" --> SAVE_REM["Update Storage"]
    SAVE_ADD --> END["End"]
    JSON_OUT --> END
    TEXT_OUT --> END
    SAVE_REM --> END
    ERR_UNK --> END
    ERR_VAL --> END
    ERR_NF --> END

sequenceDiagram
    actor User
    participant CLI as "cli.py"
    participant SVC as "service.py"
    participant STG as "storage.py"
    participant MDL as "models.py"
    User->>CLI: todo add "New Task"
    CLI->>SVC: create_task("New Task")
    SVC->>MDL: Task("description='New Task'")
    MDL-->>SVC: Task Object (with ID/Timestamp)
    SVC->>STG: save_task("task_obj")
    STG->>STG: Write to ~/.todos.json
    STG-->>SVC: Success
    SVC-->>CLI: Task Created Successfully
    CLI-->>User: "Task 1 added!"
    User->>CLI: todo list --json
    CLI->>SVC: get_all_tasks()
    SVC->>STG: read_all()
    STG-->>SVC: List of Task Objects
    SVC-->>CLI: Task Collection
    CLI->>MDL: serialize_to_json("collection")
    MDL-->>CLI: JSON String
    CLI-->>User: [ { "id": 1, ... } ]
